s.note: Andrew's home town of Sitka, Alaska
s.how: Spread rye crispbreads with cream cheese. Top with folds of smoked salmon, a sprig of dill and a few capers. Squeeze over a little lemon just before serving. A taste of an Alaskan town for a reluctant New York visitor.

s.note: the surprise welcome party at the Paxton house
s.how: Mix 250g crab meat with 250g cream cheese, 2 tbsp mayonnaise and sliced spring onion. Spread in a small dish and bake at 190C for 20 minutes until golden and bubbling. Serve hot with water crackers at the welcome party.

m.note: dinner at the Paxton family house in Alaska
m.how: Mix 2 tbsp maple syrup with a spoon of wholegrain mustard and brush over 4 salmon fillets. Roast at 200C for 15 minutes. Boil 800g baby potatoes and steam green beans, then toss both with butter. Serve together.

w.how: Beat 250g butter with 250g sugar, add 4 eggs and fold in 250g self-raising flour. Bake in 2 tins at 175C for 25 minutes. Sandwich with strawberry jam and whipped cream, ice white and top with fresh flowers for a barn wedding.

d.note: Andrew juggling Margaret's coffee on the way into the office
d.how: Pull a strong double shot of espresso into each takeaway cup. Steam milk until silky and pour in. Snap on a lid and hand it over fast, before your boss reaches the lift.
